blocks.en: # Design red flags
blocks.zh: # 设计警示信号

blocks.en: Screen every candidate before synthesis. A red flag is a reason to revise or reject the shape.
blocks.zh: 综合候选方案前，筛查每一个方案。警示信号是修改或拒绝当前结构的理由。

blocks.en: ## Shallow module
blocks.zh: ## 浅模块

blocks.en: A shallow module exposes a large interface while hiding little complexity. Judge depth by the capability and policy hidden behind the public surface relative to the size of that surface. Prefer a simple interface backed by substantial behavior.
blocks.zh: 浅模块暴露很大的接口，却只隐藏少量复杂度。判断模块深度时，比较公开接口背后封装的能力和策略与接口自身的大小。优先选择由丰富行为支撑的简单接口。

blocks.en: Do not confuse a deep module with a deep call chain. A deep call chain scatters understanding across layers. A deep module concentrates capability behind one interface.
blocks.zh: 不要把深模块与深调用链混淆。深调用链让理解分散在各层；深模块则将能力集中在一个接口之后。

blocks.en: Look for these signs:
blocks.zh: 留意这些信号：

blocks.en:
- Callers coordinate several methods to complete one operation.
- Public options expose internal stages or implementation choices.
- Learning the interface does not save the caller from learning the implementation.
blocks.zh:
- 调用方需要协调多个方法才能完成一个操作。
- 公开选项暴露内部阶段或实现选择。
- 学会接口之后，调用方仍需要学习实现。

blocks.en: ## Information leakage
blocks.zh: ## 信息泄漏

blocks.en: Information leakage makes multiple modules depend on the same internal decision. A representation, policy, or protocol detail appears in more than one place, so changing it requires coordinated edits.
blocks.zh: 信息泄漏会让多个模块依赖同一个内部决策。某种表示、策略或协议细节出现在多个地方，因此修改时需要同步调整。

blocks.en: Public re-exports of transport or wire types are leakage. Parse external data into domain types behind the interface. Keep storage schemas, framework objects, and protocol details private.
blocks.zh: 通过公开接口重新导出传输或 wire 类型也是泄漏。在接口之后将外部数据解析为领域类型。让存储 schema、框架对象和协议细节保持私有。

blocks.en: ## Temporal decomposition
blocks.zh: ## 按执行时序拆分

blocks.en: Temporal decomposition organizes modules by execution order instead of the knowledge they own. Separate load, validate, transform, and save stages often repeat one representation and its invariants across several boundaries.
blocks.zh: 按执行时序拆分，是根据执行顺序而不是模块拥有的知识来组织模块。分开的加载、校验、转换和保存阶段，常常在多个边界重复同一种表示及其不变量。

blocks.en: Group code around domain knowledge and ownership. Methods that run at different times can still belong to one module when they protect the same decisions.
blocks.zh: 围绕领域知识和职责归属组织代码。在不同时刻运行的方法，如果保护的是同一组决策，仍可以属于同一个模块。

blocks.en: ## Pass-through method
blocks.zh: ## 透传方法

blocks.en: A pass-through method forwards the same arguments to another method with the same shape. It adds a layer without hiding complexity.
blocks.zh: 透传方法将同一组参数转发给形状相同的另一个方法。它增加一层，却没有隐藏复杂度。

blocks.en: Remove it or move responsibility to the module that can complete the operation. Keep a forwarding boundary only when it adds policy, adaptation, or a distinct abstraction.
blocks.zh: 删除它，或把职责移到能完整执行操作的模块。只有转发边界增加了策略、适配或独立抽象时才保留。

blocks.en: ## Split ownership
blocks.zh: ## 分散的状态归属

blocks.en: More than one module writes the same state or keeps its own copy of it. An agent that edits one writer can't see the others, so their rules diverge.
blocks.zh: 不止一个模块写入相同的状态，或者各自维护一份状态副本。编辑其中一个写入者的 agent 看不到其他写入者，导致各处规则逐渐分化脱节。

blocks.en: Give each piece of state one owner. Other modules read it or ask the owner to change it.
blocks.zh: 让每一处状态拥有唯一的 owner。其他模块只能读取它，或请求 owner 进行更改。

blocks.en: ## Two ways to do one task
blocks.zh: ## 同一任务存在两种完成途径

blocks.en: The design supports more than one way to do the same task. An agent copies whichever way it finds first, so every way keeps gaining callers.
blocks.zh: 架构设计支持用多种方式完成相同的任务。agent 会复制它最先找到的方式，导致每种途径的使用者都在不断增加。

blocks.en: Keep one way. Move callers off the others and delete them in the same change.
blocks.zh: 只保留一种途径。在同一个改动中将调用方从其他途径迁走，并彻底删除废弃途径。

blocks.en: ## Importable internals
blocks.zh: ## 可被直接导入的内部实现

blocks.en: A caller can import a module's internals. An agent takes the shortest path that compiles, so it imports them directly and they become part of the interface.
blocks.zh: 调用方能够 import 模块的内部实现。agent 往往采取能通过编译的最短路径，因而会直接导入内部实现，使其不知不觉变成了公共接口的一部分。

blocks.en: Make internals unreachable from outside the module, so an import from outside fails the build.
blocks.zh: 让内部实现从模块外部完全无法触及，使得来自外部的 import 直接构建失败。

blocks.en: ## Hand-synced list
blocks.zh: ## 手工同步的列表

blocks.en: Two or more places list the same items, and adding an item means editing every list. An agent that sees one list updates only that one.
blocks.zh: 两个或多个地方列出了相同的条目，增加一个条目意味着需要编辑每一处列表。只看到一处列表的 agent 只会更新那一个地方。

blocks.en: Keep one list and derive the others from it. If a list can't be derived, make the build fail when the lists disagree.
blocks.zh: 只保留一份列表，其他列表均从中派生。如果某份列表无法自动派生，则在列表不一致时让构建直接失败。
